text: A student has a sample of copper(II) sulfate crystals, CuSO •xH O. The student wants to show that
The student uses the following method.
step 1 Weigh a clean crucible on a balance reading to two decimal places. Record the mass.
step 2 Place the sample of CuSO •xH O into the crucible. Record the mass.
step 3 Heat the crucible gently for about 1 minute then strongly for about 4 minutes.
step 4 Weigh the crucible and contents. Record the mass.
